Essence — валюта для улучшений. Она не з: Essence is a currency for upgrades. It doesn't take inventory space: it sits on the profile's balance, each kind separately (max 2 billion of each).
Главное применение — звёзды на предметах: The main use is stars on items (✪). Each star gives +2% to the item's stats, and +10% per star for dungeon items inside the Catacombs. Usually there are 5 stars; Kuudra armor and Crimson Isle weapons get up to 10 for Crimson Essence, and Infernal up to 15.
Второе применение — магазины эссенций (E: The second use is essence shops (Essence Shop): perks bought once that last forever. The most useful are Forbidden perks for Wither Essence: stats everywhere, not just in dungeons.
На Bazaar эссенции покупаются только с C: On the Bazaar essence can be bought only from Catacombs 20. The exception is Forest Essence: it can be bought right away.
Звёзды ставят в меню Essence Crafting (N: Stars are applied in the Essence Crafting menu (NPC Malik). Stars stay on the item: sell the item and the essence goes with it (and a starred item is worth more).
Цена — мгновенная продажа на Bazaar. «Пе: Price is Bazaar instant sell. "Perks" is how many shop perks are fully upgraded.
